statements.claim: Museum inventory lists a 1860 Zaptiye Çavuş medal as silver.

A 36.6 mm, 4.34 g bronze object dated 1277/1860 is catalogued as Çâvuş-ı zabtiyye rozeti; SALT notes that it is more likely a simple insignia used by gendarmerie sergeants and that the observed version is probably a trial.

decision: Keep the documented silver award in the unpictured appendix. Do not substitute the SALT bronze trial/badge for the formal medal, and do not count it as a formal award family variant until the identity is resolved.

image_access.notes: The public SALT metadata page lists ANUY00011.jpg and ANUY00011A001.jpg, but both file links redirect to the SALT login page. No access control was bypassed and no image was downloaded.
